name: Smoky Grilled Pork (Vawksa Rep)
ingredients: 500 g pork belly, cut into 2-inch chunks
1 cup fermented bamboo shoot (tung-rim), drained and rinsed
Fresh bamboo skewers (or metal skewers) for grilling
instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine pork, bamboo shoot, dried chilies, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, salt, and mustard oil. Mix well and marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight in the refrigerator.
2. Preheat a charcoal grill or prepare a wood fire until you have glowing embers.
3. Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving space between each piece. Alternatively, wrap portions in banana leaves and tie securely.

4. Grill the skewers over the embers, turning frequently, for 20-25 minutes until the pork is cooked through and charred on the edges. For banana leaf wraps, cook for 30-35 minutes, turning occasionally.
5. Occasional basting with leftover marinade enhances flavor and moisture.
6. Serve hot with steamed rice or as a side dish. Garnish with fresh coriander and sliced onions if desired.
description: A smoky, heart-warming embrace of fermented bamboo and mountain herbs, kissed by open flames.
